profile_text.body:
# Credo AI

Credo AI, founded in 2020, describes itself as "the Trusted Leader in AI Governance." The company's platform enables enterprises to discover AI systems, enforce policies, prove compliance, and manage risk across models, agents, and applications. The company created what it characterizes as the AI governance category and states it is now defining "Agent Governance" with capabilities including agent registry, agentic risk controls, and governance frameworks. The platform includes GAIA (Govern AI Assistant), described as generally available, and integrates with 300+ existing systems.

The Credo AI platform offers pre-built policy packs with regulatory intelligence for EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and other standards. The company states these policy packs were written by team members involved in standards-making at ISO, NIST, the EU Parliament, NATO, and OECD. Core features include model-level, application-level, and agent-level governance in a single platform, contextual and continuous policy enforcement, automated workflows, and audit-ready evidence generation. The company emphasizes a purpose-built governance approach rather than AI features added to existing governance tools.

Credo AI reports customer deployments across insurance, financial services, federal, and healthcare sectors, with named references to usage by Mastercard and IBM. The company notes partnerships including collaboration with IBM on Compliance Accelerators. No litigation, SEC filings, or MCP server entries are currently held in the tracked facts for this company.
